## Summary

What problem does this change solve? Link the related issue when available.

## Validation

List the exact checks and results. Mark blocked or unrun checks and explain why.
Native behavior, installation, and updates need separate platform evidence.

## Documentation and compatibility

Describe user-visible changes, documentation/changelog updates, and any permission,
identity, migration, recovery, or distribution impact. Write “None” when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant regression coverage and checks are included, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Screenshots, logs, and fixtures contain no private data or credentials.
